dict.string: SUBQUERY(extensionItems, $item, $item.attachments.@count >= 1 AND SUBQUERY($item.attachments, $attachment, ANY $attachment.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "net.daringfireball.markdown" OR ANY $attachment.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.markdown" OR ANY $attachment.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "io.github.xbtdmt.vitrine.mdx" OR ANY $attachment.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "io.github.xbtdmt.vitrine.mdc" OR ANY $attachment.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "io.github.xbtdmt.vitrine.qmd" OR ANY $attachment.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "io.github.xbtdmt.vitrine.rmd" OR ANY $attachment.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "org.textbundle.package" OR ANY $attachment.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "org.python.restructuredtext" OR ANY $attachment.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "org.asciidoc.asciidoc" OR ANY $attachment.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "org.orgmode.org").@count == $item.attachments.@count).@count >= 1
